settings.question: How much is delivery and how long does it take?
settings.answer: Delivery anywhere in the Republic of Ireland is €15. Most stock items arrive in 2–3 working days; each product page shows its own delivery estimate.

settings.question: Do your prices include VAT?
settings.answer: Yes. All prices on the website include VAT at 23%.

settings.question: Can you supply mats in custom sizes?
settings.answer: Yes. Most entrance matting can be cut to fit your matwell or floor area. Send us your measurements and we will quote.

settings.question: Can I return a logo mat?
settings.answer: Logo mats are made to order, so they cannot be refunded once you have approved the proof.
